=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text lq "<<<"
text rq ">>>"
text tlen " length "
text tuni ": all unique\n"
text tdup ": duplicate '"
text tat "' at "
text tand " and "
text u0 "."
text u1 "abcABC"
text u2 "XYZ ZYX"
text u3 "1234567890ABCDEFGHIJKLMN0PQRSTUVWXYZ"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emitc writes one byte
fn emitc c uchar to void
b = new uchar 1 0
put b 0 c
emit b
end
note the first byte (smallest i) that occurs again later, with the place j of its next occurrence
fn show a view uchar * to void
emit lq
emit a
emit rq
emit tlen
emitu len a
for i ulong len a
for j ulong sub sub len a i 1
k = add add i j 1
if eq get a i get a k
emit tdup
emitc get a i
emit tat
emitu i
emit tand
emitu k
emit nl
ret
end
end
end
emit tuni
end
fn main to int
note the empty string, as a slice of length 0
show part u0 0 0
show u0
show u1
show u2
show u3
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
&lt;&lt;&lt;>>> length 0: all unique
&lt;&lt;&lt;.>>> length 1: all unique
&lt;&lt;&lt;abcABC>>> length 6: all unique
&lt;&lt;&lt;XYZ ZYX>>> length 7: duplicate 'X' at 0 and 6
&lt;&lt;&lt;1234567890ABCDEFGHIJKLMN0PQRSTUVWXYZ>>> length 36: duplicate '0' at 9 and 24
</pre>
